craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-adbhuta of reductio pressed to the turn — vitarka as each escape collapses into consequence. Churn-never-ceases; sevenfold-no-release; ironic āho per UNC (objectors triumph voiced to collapse). Rejected: (a) unironic triumph → killed: irony drives to v52. Read aloud: THE-root WOULD-churn … SEV-en-FOLD na-TURE GRANTS-no re-LEASE.

lines: The Root would churn its own effects and never cease;
oh, never — sevenfold nature grants no release!
l4.sanskrit_cite: na viramen mūlakāraṇam āho na viramati

reads_against.argmap: Ceaseless churning — whose liberation? → Nature-alone never releases — hence a perceiving maker (v52).
c1_essence: Unperceived buddhi grounds no purpose; generic will forces omniscience on each; perception-by-all mixes appearances unless One holds them (vv37-41).
Nature's kit needs no purpose and purpose is courtesy-speech — yet the root-cause would never cease, so no liberation without a perceiving maker (vv42-45).
reads_against.c1_rasa: raudra-adbhuta of reductio pressed to the turn
